title: Structure-Driven Methodology: An Emerging Cross-Domain Paradigm
summary: This article proposes and articulates structure-driven methodology as an emerging cross-domain paradigm. In contrast to the objective-driven paradigm that has dominated inverse-problem solving for over two centuries, structure-driven methodology advocates identifying and exploiting the intrinsic structure of a problem to construct the solution method directly, rather than approaching the solution through iterative search.
